title: Viewport & R3F Canvas — Orthographic Camera, Layer Rendering, Shader Materials
description: Create the Viewport component with a React Three Fiber Canvas using orthographic camera with pan/zoom controls. Render the layer tree from ProjectStore as a Three.js scene graph: ImageLayerMesh (textured planes from loaded images), TextLayerMesh (drei Text component), ShaderLayerGroup (custom ShaderMaterial compiled from shader component GLSL with bound uniforms). Adapt existing resize handles from EditorTestBed. Add ViewportControls for camera manipulation.
acceptance_criteria: ImageLayerMesh renders textured plane from loaded image data
TextLayerMesh renders text using drei Text component
ShaderLayerGroup applies custom ShaderMaterial from shader component GLSL
Shader uniforms bound to MobX observables for live updates
Layer visibility respected (hidden layers not rendered)
Layer ordering matches tree order (z-index/render order)
Resize handles adapted from EditorTestBed reference implementation
useThreeScoped and withThreeDispose utilities used for cleanup
TypeScript strict mode passes with no errors
completion_summary: All 6 Viewport files written and typecheck passes clean. R3F Canvas with orthographic camera, ViewportControls (pan/zoom), ImageLayerMesh, TextLayerMesh, ShaderLayerGroup with dynamic shader materials and uniform binding.
